notice: Light news day — fewer fresh items than usual.

lead.title: Lab is a local-first, serverless browser client for LLMs
lead.summary: Lab launches as a local-first, serverless browser client for running LLMs, pitched as a chat and experimentation UI that targets local inference workflows with no server component. It stands out as the most general-purpose new interface in a window otherwise crowded with niche agent tooling.

top_stories.title: Astah Pro MCP lets AI agents design UML models locally
top_stories.summary: A local MCP server plugin for Astah Professional lets AI agents design and explain UML models, generate code from models and back, and build diagrams from hand-drawn sketches via programmatic tool calling.

top_stories.title: Lumae: a macOS screen recorder AI agents can edit over MCP
top_stories.summary: Lumae is a free native macOS screen recorder and screenshot tool whose recordings AI agents can edit over MCP, with automatic zoom, smooth cursor, motion blur, captions, and annotation callouts.

top_stories.title: DeepSeek reportedly accelerates STAR Market IPO work with CITIC Securities as sponsor
top_stories.summary: DeepSeek is reportedly preparing a Shanghai STAR Market listing with CITIC Securities as sponsor, targeting an A-share debut in 2026-2027, following a June round of about $7.2B at roughly $56B post-money.

top_stories.title: OpenAI's Altman says going public in 2026 would be 'ill-advised'
top_stories.summary: Despite a confidential IPO filing, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says the company will not list in 2026, pushing any debut beyond this year amid heavy demand and infrastructure spend.

items.title: Structured transforms cut quantization overhead from O(N²) to O(N log N)
items.summary: Replacing dense random orthogonal matrices with sign-randomized DCT transforms makes Kashin-decomposition-based weight quantization far cheaper while staying competitive with OPTQ, QuIP and QuIP-RG at 4-bit per channel, and remaining numerically stable where QuIP diverges on Pythia-6.9B and Mistral-7B.

items.title: LILA prunes LLMs with no calibration data and beats an RL pruning policy
items.summary: A calibration-free scoring method based on latent spectral geometry and KS distances outperforms PruneNet's 45M-parameter RL policy by 1.57pp on LLaMA-2-7B at 25% sparsity and beats WikiText-2-calibrated SliceGPT by up to 6pp.

items.title: Negative Self-Distillation trains models to avoid their own flawed reasoning
items.summary: NSD makes LLMs diverge from their own flawed reasoning traces instead of imitating ground-truth solutions, countering on-policy self-distillation's tendency to suppress uncertainty and self-correction on complex reasoning tasks.

items.title: X-AuT compresses speech-LLM audio encoders and lowers error rates
items.summary: Progressive audio-encoder compression with cross-scale distillation cut macro-average error on Qwen3-ASR-0.6B from 5.61% to 5.27% across ten Chinese-English benchmarks while the language-model backbone stayed frozen.

items.title: EMMI compresses multimodal representations for edge MLLM inference
items.summary: Fused representation compression reduces the compute, memory and communication demands of running multimodal LLMs on resource-constrained edge platforms across vision, text and telemetry modalities.

items.title: Qwen3.6-based delib/sonnet fine-tune lands on Hugging Face
items.summary: A Qwen3.6 fine-tune from the dougalldeepmind experimental line was uploaded Sept 12 with safetensors weights, part of the ongoing delib/sonnet series.

items.title: Qwen3.6 agent-advice checkpoint uploaded Sept 12
items.summary: A second in-window upload from dougalldeepmind focuses on agentic advice and reasoning traces; minor but genuine new weights for the reporting window.

items.title: llama.cpp b10937 extends OpenCL row-alignment rule to more quant formats
items.summary: Daily build b10937 extends the noshuffle row-alignment rule in the OpenCL backend to q4_K, q5_K and q8_0 quantizations, previously limited to q6_K.

items.title: agent-dev-team: a tiered engineering team configured for AI coding tools
items.summary: A configurable add-on for local AI coding agents ships 21 role agents across four seniority tiers, 26 portable workflow skills and an escalation protocol, working with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, OpenCode and GitHub Copilot.

items.title: Sorify: an open-source, MCP-managed browser automation platform
items.summary: An AI-first browser testing and automation platform managed entirely through MCP, with low token consumption, a scheduler, CI webhooks and a Chrome extension that records events for agents.

items.title: no_human runs a full ticket-to-PR pipeline on-device
items.summary: A free, open-source pipeline that runs entirely on your machine, handling development from issue ticket to reviewed pull request using AI coding agents.

items.title: Tom's Hardware benchmarks Qwen 3.8 on RTX 5090 — VRAM alone can't beat software bottlenecks
items.summary: This week's hardware roundup finds VRAM capacity alone cannot overcome severe software and inference-engine bottlenecks when benchmarking Qwen 3.8 27B, alongside coverage of the splintered compute economy and GPU/memory pricing pressure.

items.title: Nvidia sells Founder's Edition RTX 50-series cards at MSRP during PAX West
items.summary: Nvidia offered RTX 5090 ($1,999), RTX 5080 ($999) and RTX 5070 ($549) Founder's Edition cards at original launch MSRP to Verified Priority Access attendees, amid the 2026 GPU price premium environment.
